artifact: name of the thing under test
note: Write this before round 1 and never edit it. If you find yourself wanting to revise the charter mid-run, that impulse is itself the finding.

core_claims.text: The single sentence the artifact would be pointless without.
core_claims.falsifiable_by: What observation would show this claim false. If you cannot fill this in, the loop has no fitness signal and will run on rhetoric alone.

supporting_claims.text: Claims the artifact could lose and still be worth having.

out_of_scope: Stated up front so the proposer cannot invent scope limits mid-run to escape a finding. Anything not listed here is in scope for the whole run.

prediction.note: Observer discipline. Fill this in before starting, or the run will confirm whatever you already believed.
prediction.expected_first_casualty: which core claim you think falls first
